Hero.title: Agent-Native Terminal Environment
Hero.subtitle: Built for the next generation of AI-driven developers. A fully integrated workbench pairing a high-performance native core with an intuitive, unified workspace.

Features.panel1_desc: Drastically reduces LLM context window pressure by exposing only 6 meta-tools. The agent discovers and runs specific capabilities dynamically over a virtual path system, mitigating selection errors and hallucinations.
Features.panel2_desc: Operates native applications silently in the background using Accessibility APIs (macOS AX, Windows UI Automation, Linux AT-SPI) instead of capturing screenshots and clicking screen coordinates, preventing user focus hijacking.
Features.panel3_desc: Resolves conversational history and developer context using a vector-hybrid retrieval model. Employs version-control patterns (git-like revisions, CAS conflict detection, and incremental updates) to synchronize state seamlessly across devices.
Features.panel4_desc: Enforces strict modularity and boundary control using complexity linters. Prevents code regression by locking baseline budgets, directing new features to focused modules.

Architecture.title: Decoupled Native Architecture
Architecture.subtitle: Low Latency, Safe Orchestration
Architecture.desc: Lyra separates presentation layers from native execution. Electron acts as a lightweight TypeScript platform bridge while all heavy lifting (PTY execution, filesystem traversal, OS accessibility hooks) runs on the native Rust daemon (lyrad) via high-performance N-API bindings.
